name: Wanna Peek? Candy Bunnies
summary:
Wanna Peek? Candy Bunnies is an Easter-themed hentai puzzle game inspired by the Gals Panic series. The player must strategically draw lines to remove sections of the overlay, gradually revealing the hidden bunny girl images beneath. However, they must evade enemies, as both the player and the drawn line are vulnerable to attacks.

The player can defeat enemies by trapping them within segments, earning valuable rewards such as bonus time, extra lives, and power-ups. Each main level also contains a hidden Easter egg, which, when discovered and the basket is captured, unlocks a special bonus level and exclusive artwork.
